Vendored locally:
  - css/mana.min.css   (from npm mana-font@1.18.0/css/mana.min.css)
                       — local edit: @font-face rewritten to reference woff2
                         only, since that's the only font format we vendor
  - fonts/mana.woff2   (from npm mana-font@1.18.0/fonts/mana.woff2)

Used to render WUBRG mana symbols in the league deck viewer.
